answers.text: Model inter-AZ, inter-Region, NAT gateway, CloudFront, and data-transfer paths before choosing the architecture
Use AWS Trusted Advisor as a packet-capture utility
Use NAT gateways for all service-to-service traffic without modeling data processing and transfer charges
Use a single NAT gateway for private subnets across all AZs

explanations.a: Data transfer can be a major cost driver in distributed designs.
explanations.b: Trusted Advisor is a best-practice checker, not a packet-capture tool.
explanations.c: Service review for pricing models identifies the gap: the transfer-cost review shows that unmodeled egress and NAT processing can dominate distributed workload cost. The pricing models requirement needs an architecture choice that fits the business constraint rather than this alternative.
explanations.d: A single AZ NAT is a single point of failure; deploy a NAT gateway per AZ.

questions.text: A media company is launching a high-traffic streaming companion application. The launch must satisfy business, operational, and governance goals while addressing storage tiering. Which design choice is most appropriate?
